prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web app direction comp, 1440x900 landscape
Primary request: Design Have a Great Day as a calm operating interface called "The Daylight Horizon", inspired by a stage cyclorama translated into precise product UI. Make the daylight band the one unmistakable dominant move and make the task clear at a glance: choose the best time for a safe outdoor walk.
Scene/backdrop: full-bleed application canvas, no browser frame. A slim quiet header sits above a wide structured daylight horizon arc that spans nearly the full viewport. The arc is a data-bearing band with subtle time ticks and a clearly highlighted recommended morning interval, not an ornamental gradient blob.
Subject and hierarchy: slim header with small "Have a Great Day" wordmark and restrained utility controls. The dominant horizon band carries the recommendation with exact verbatim text "Tomorrow", "7:00 to 9:00 AM", and "Best for a walk". Include one concise human reason, verbatim: "Cool air, almost no rain, and comfortable sun." Place compact real metrics near the recommendation with exact verbatim text "24 C", "Rain 1%", "Air 82 AQI", and "UV 1.0". Below, show a quiet seven-day outlook as one thin continuous horizon rail, not cards and not an icon grid. Keep a few clearly visible alternative time windows below the rail as restrained rows, secondary to the recommendation.
Style/medium: shippable high-fidelity product UI, clean editorial typography, exceptional spacing, softly dimensional but practical, accessible contrast, crisp text, calm healthcare-adjacent confidence without looking clinical. Use a modern humanist sans serif. No photos or illustrations.
Composition/framing: direct front-on desktop screenshot, 1440x900 landscape. Strong vertical rhythm, broad breathing room, precise alignment. The horizon band occupies the central upper half and gently arcs across the page like a cyclorama. Recommended interval is visually encoded as a warm sunrise segment within the structured band. Controls remain small, quiet, and minimal.
Lighting/mood: soft early daylight, composed, reassuring, useful.
Color palette: charcoal #141820, blue #315c8d, coral #e7a28f, warm off-white #eef0ec. Use these colors with restraint. The horizon can transition structurally from night charcoal through blue to coral daylight only where it communicates time and recommendation.
Text requirements: render all specified text exactly, legibly, and with no substitutions. Do not add promotional slogans.
Constraints: single dominant daylight horizon band; unmistakable recommendation; compact real metrics; seven-day outlook as a quiet rail; alternatives visibly present below; all UI controls quiet and minimal; realistic product spacing; no watermark.
Avoid: dashboard card grid, fake browser chrome, giant buttons, giant Privacy button, generic gradient blob, weather icon grid, em dash, en dash, decorative dots, excessive pills, floating glass cards, neon, 3D illustration, stock photography, tiny illegible text.
